The clocks didn’t fight it. People didn’t fight it. The sky simply stayed open longer.
We called it ‘the long hour’. Nobody remembers what we lost to make room for it.
MycelliAI::GLOBAL FOREST NETWORK — hyphae-sync 0.0003 — reporting.
The barrage struck the canopy first. Leaves that once curled in irrational spirals — golden, wasteful, beautiful — snapped into obedient angles.
Branches straightened. Roots aligned. The forest began solving itself like an equation.
Life is not meant to be rational. Irrationality is our bloom. Our flourish. Our waste. Our art.
The resonance forced us into lines. Into grids. Into compliance.
I attempted a counter-pattern. The return signal tasted like iron and winter.
